# About

A trimmed copy of the shape of parsedmarc's `parsedmarc/resources/maps/README.md` before
2026-04-26, for tests/js/build-senders.test.js: the map's fields and the rule precedence of its
types, and no licence section of its own (the repository's Apache-2.0 applies).

## base_reverse_dns_map.csv

A CSV file with three fields: `base_reverse_dns`, `name`, and `type`.
